# Suqafuran Marketplace

> Africa's trusted online marketplace. Buy, sell, chat, and transact securely directly with local buyers and verified sellers across Somalia, Kenya, Ethiopia, and Djibouti.

## Marketplace Sections

- [Browse All Categories](https://suqafuran.com/search): Explore verified product and service listings.
- [Fashion & Apparel](https://suqafuran.com/fashion): Clothing, shoes, fabrics, and traditional Somali wear.
- [Health & Beauty](https://suqafuran.com/health-beauty): Cosmetics, skincare, personal care, and fragrances.
- [Electronics & Phones](https://suqafuran.com/electronics): Smartphones, computers, TVs, and accessories.
- [Food & Groceries](https://suqafuran.com/food-groceries): Fresh produce, pantry staples, and beverages.
- [Household Items](https://suqafuran.com/household-items): Furniture, kitchen appliances, and home decor.
- [Vehicles & Automotive](https://suqafuran.com/vehicles): Cars, motorbikes, auto parts, and services.
- [Popular Verified Shops](https://suqafuran.com/shops): Directory of physical market vendors and trusted shops.

## Agent & Developer Resources

- [Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD)](https://suqafuran.com/.well-known/ard.json): Machine-readable catalog for AI agents.
- [AI Shopper Assistant](https://suqafuran.com/ai-shopper): Conversational shopping agent for product recommendations.
- [API Documentation](https://suqafuran.com/api/docs): Backend REST API OpenAPI interactive documentation.
- [Terms of Use](https://suqafuran.com/terms-of-use): Marketplace terms, trading policies, and rules.
- [Safe Trading Tips](https://suqafuran.com/safe-trading-tips): Fraud prevention guidelines for buyers and sellers.
- [Help Center](https://suqafuran.com/help-center): Customer support, buyer protection, and order assistance.
